portrait_policy: User authorizes replacing all chatbox portraits to match redesigned cast. Preserve narrative identity and consistent face/hair/clothes between dialogue, gameplay and cutscenes. Derive mouth/expression/blink frames after model design stabilization.
subsequent_cutscene_phase: After all ImageGen cast concepts, Blender cast art and full animation review: author genuine detailed Blender-animated FMV replacements for existing cutscenes, using approved cast identities, AI character voices via user API, lipsync/body/hands/camera acting, Godot subtitles/skip/music/input transitions; preserve current fallbacks until each replacement is validated.
narrative_authorization: User explicitly authorizes additional story and dialogue for FMV cutscenes where useful. Maintain established character identity, continuity, gameplay objectives and consequences; write final script before voice generation, then validate synchronized acting and transitions.
subsequent_ui_phase: User authorizes redesign of all menu art/layouts, HUD, popups, studio Inverted Index symbol and pre-main-intro background through ImageGen/Blender/Godot. Align with approved cast/world art, preserve readable functional navigation and audio routing; studio neon traces icon outline, no detached red orb. Created-by Gilberto Lopes identity retained.
studio_redesign_authorization: User explicitly permits changing the logo design, Inverted Index presentation, Created by Gilberto Lopes presentation and background images to match the new art direction. Retain correct studio and creator names, coherent typography, outline-following neon animation and validated splash-to-main-intro/menu transition.
visual_target: User requires ImageGen-level visual detail and coherent art across entire game. Evaluate actual Godot gameplay, menus and cutscenes; concept sheets alone are not completion. Use detailed pre-rendered environments plus Blender interactive cast/props, consistent lighting/materials, readable gameplay and measured performance.
resolution_requirement: Preserve existing 3840x2160 window preset and native fullscreen support. Validate actual 4K gameplay/UI/FMVs, aspect ratios, readable text, art sharpness and measured performance; do not equate existing output size preset with full visual/performance validation.
nightmare_victim_variants: User specifies nightmare zombies are recognizable people Cass killed in real-world levels, with more variants. Derive undead appearances from final living cast identities (face/hair/clothes/silhouette), track real campaign victims individually including look variant and source mission; civilians only if previously killed. Current code stores killed_civilian flags but no full enemy identity ledger observed. Design/logic not implemented or validated yet. Preserve generated generic zombie only as shared material direction, not sole final nightmare population.
undead_art_workflow: After living concept batch, derive recognizable zombie concept variants using living identity references and stylized gore/material treatment; Blender variants share rig structure with corresponding living character while keeping creature animation distinct. Do not invent anonymous replacements for known victims or include surviving civilians.
